name: AIDA Framework
description: Guides consumer through 4 psychological milestones: grabbing attention with bold hooks, sparking interest with product science, triggering desire with lifestyle transformations, and driving immediate action with clear CTAs.

name: StoryBrand 7-Part Framework
description: Positions the customer as the hero, the problem as the villain, the brand as the trusted guide giving a clear plan, and calls them to action to avoid failure and achieve triumph.

name: Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD)
description: Focuses on the emotional and functional job the customer hires the product to accomplish (e.g. 'I hire bio-peptide serum to look radiant at corporate presentations without breaking out').

name: STP Marketing Strategy
description: Divides market into distinct buyer segments, targets high-value niches, and crafts uncontested brand positioning.

name: Blue Ocean Strategy
description: Makes competition irrelevant by creating a leap in value for buyers and the company, breaking the value-cost trade-off.
